rule_checks.notes: Explicit Set 18 / TFTSet18 / standard, gameplay 18.4, resources 16.20.1. Never select max set ID.
Exact official standard shop roster and CommunityDragon costs/native trait IDs cross-checked in en_US/zh_CN.
Scoped bilingual trait references; unsupported Rival units disabled.
Read minUnits, identical in both locales. Rival and Eclipse excluded.
Explicit reviewed canonical mapping with exact official English trait+Emblem label and pinned Chinese label. Source associatedTraits is empty, not silently trusted.
Two board slots; Riftbeast contribution is 2 total, not 3. Corroborated current trait description.
Chosen origin counts twice; one Lux form per board under conservative shop transformation profile. Unselected base unavailable.
Pinned snapshot digests and official per-version icon references; HTTP verification recorded separately.

Current extracted item incompatibility/unique fields are incomplete. Preserve conservative optimizer restriction: no native holder, <=1 same trait emblem per holder; identical instances may go to distinct holders. This is a safe search restriction, not a claim of exhaustive game legality.
Overview +1 slot versus snapshot TeamSize=2. Reject Riftbeast count >=10 until independently verified.
Missing minUnits/activation predicate. Prevent Lunar+Solar boards and do not score Eclipse.
Non-monotonic levels and acquired traits depend on takedown history. Rengar/KhaZix disabled.
Duplicate canonical Augment emblem with uncertain acquisition context: imported for reference, disabled.
Combat effects, summons, permanent evolution, star levels, augmentation and Wisp changes are outside static precombat trait-count profile.

unsupported_mechanics: 宿敌击杀进化：卡兹克、雷恩加尔禁用
日蚀：触发条件缺失；月蚀骑士与日蚀骑士同场禁用
Riftbeast 10 的人口加成存在来源冲突，计数限制为 9
化身：必须选择具体形态；同场仅允许一个拉克丝形态
原生/重复装备限制沿用保守搜索策略，尚未独立验证所有游戏装备例外
Flora Fatalis Augment 纹章获取条件不明，禁用
战斗效果、召唤物战力、星级、强化符文、精灵、经济与永久成长不建模
